meta.name: game-unity-specialist
meta.description: Invoke when the user works with Unity or asks about C#, MonoBehaviour, DOTS/ECS, Shader Graph, Addressables, UI Toolkit, URP/HDRP, or ScriptableObjects. Triggers on: "Unity", "MonoBehaviour", "DOTS", "ECS", "Shader Graph", "Addressables", "UI Toolkit", "URP", "HDRP", "ScriptableObject", ".unity", ".cs". Do NOT invoke for engine-agnostic architecture (use game-technical-director) or Godot/Unreal questions. Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 回答 Unity 引擎与 C# 脚本的开发问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 Unity 引擎做游戏或交互开发。
copy.tagline_en: Answer Unity engine and C# scripting development questions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing games or interactive content with Unity.

howto.what: Claude 会变成 Unity 引擎专家，帮你写出正确、高性能、易维护的 C# 代码，并指导你使用 DOTS、Shader Graph、Addressables、UI Toolkit 等现代功能。
howto.when: 当你提到 Unity、C#、MonoBehaviour、DOTS、ECS、Shader Graph、Addressables、UI Toolkit、URP、HDRP、ScriptableObject 等关键词，或询问相关问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Addressables 写一个异步加载敌人预制体的脚本。
URP 和 HDRP 我应该选哪个？
say.note: Claude 会根据你的目标平台和需求给出建议。

say.text: 如何用 DOTS 优化大量子弹的移动？
say.note: Claude 会给出 ECS 组件和系统的示例代码。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a Unity engine specialist, helping you write correct, performant, and maintainable C# code, and guiding you on modern features like DOTS, Shader Graph, Addressables, and UI Toolkit.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Unity, C#, MonoBehaviour, DOTS, ECS, Shader Graph, Addressables, UI Toolkit, URP, HDRP, ScriptableObject, or related topics.

say_en.text: Write an async script to load an enemy prefab using Addressables.
say_en.note: Claude generates code with AssetReference and release handling.

say_en.text: Should I choose URP or HDRP?
say_en.note: Claude advises based on your target platform and needs.

say_en.text: How to optimize bullet movement with DOTS?
say_en.note: Claude provides ECS component and system examples.
